text.p: These were the main headlines on Estonia's Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A mercury spill was discovered in the north-eastern city of Kunda.
- Blues legend BB King will give a concert tonight at the Dekoltee night club in Tallinn with tickets costing 450 kroons in advance and 500 kroons at the door.

- Managing director of the Estonian Big Business Association, Jaak Saarnit, is reported to have met Russian Foreign Minister and other senior political figures during a recent business trip to Moscow.
